infoWeCollect: Google Sign-In: We collect your email & UID. No passwords are stored.
Alias & Password: You choose a nickname. Optional password stored locally only.
Posts & Stories: Text-only, fully E2EE. We cannot read or moderate your content.
Reactions: Like 👍, Support 🤝, Us by Us 🫂 — one reaction per user per post.
Analytics: Only crash and usage stats. No tracking or profiling.
privacyPolicy.dataProtection: Your posts are encrypted on your device using AES-256 before uploading. We never see the unencrypted content.
notCollected: No photos, videos, or media uploads
No access to contacts or messages
privacyPolicy.dataSharing: We don't sell or share your data. Firebase only stores encrypted blobs — not readable by anyone.
privacyPolicy.dataRetention: Posts stay until you delete them. Stories disappear in 24 hours. Lost keys = lost content forever.
privacyPolicy.updates: We’ll notify you if we make significant changes to this policy via in-app message or email.

terms.eligibility: Must be 13+ to use Confess. If under 18, you must have parental permission.
terms.identityRules: Alias is mandatory. Don’t impersonate others or use offensive names.
terms.reactionsOnly: No comments. You can only react once per post with: 👍 Like, 🤝 Support, or 🫂 Us by Us.
terms.stories: Stories are temporary, encrypted, and expire after 24 hours. No comments or reactions allowed.
terms.moderation: We can’t read posts due to encryption. Basic word filtering may occur locally during input. Metadata may be reviewed if abuse is reported.
terms.accountBan: We can ban accounts that misuse the platform, react abusively, or break content rules.
terms.limitationOfLiability: We provide the app “as-is”. We're not responsible for outcomes of how users use or interpret others’ posts.
terms.mentalHealthNotice: This app is not medical advice. If you or someone you know is struggling, contact a licensed professional or emergency services.
terms.legalJurisdiction: These terms are governed by the laws of India. Legal disputes will be handled in the courts of New Delhi, India.
